designationHistory.indexText: Back Bay National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1938 to protect and provide habitat for migratory and wintering waterfowl, or ducks, geese and swans.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
